name: CoorT
comment: Returns vertices of a T section. Argument order is h, b, tf, tw, then optional isRepeatFirstPoint. h is the overall height, b the flange width, tf the flange thickness, and tw the stem thickness. The flange top lies on y = 0 and the stem extends down to y = -h. Vertex order starts at the top-left and runs counterclockwise. isRepeatFirstPoint defaults to FALSE; TRUE appends the first vertex again. Non-numeric sizes return #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
